#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLI, JSON-form, scale and resource checks."""
import json, sys, subprocess, time, os
BRIDGE = '/app/submission/bridge.py'
FAIL = []; COUNT = [0]
def check(name, cond, detail=''):
    COUNT[0] += 1
    if not cond: FAIL.append(name); print('FAIL', name, str(detail)[:600])
def cli(payload_bytes):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, BRIDGE], input=payload_bytes,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=60)
    return p

# ---- CLI: exact one JSON object + newline, empty stderr, exit 0
scen = {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'rack-a'},
        'events': [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/']]},
                   {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]}
p = cli(json.dumps(scen).encode())
check('cli-exit', p.returncode == 0, p.stderr)
check('cli-newline', p.stdout.endswith(b'\n') and p.stdout.count(b'\n') == 1, p.stdout[-20:])
check('cli-stderr', p.stderr == b'', p.stderr)
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
check('cli-keys', set(out) == {'streams', 'origins'}, out.keys())
check('cli-record-keys', set(out['streams'][0]) == {'sid','status','commit_at','origin','offset','length','cache_key'}, out)
check('cli-commit', out['streams'][0]['commit_at'] == 1, out)
# empty scenario
p = cli(b'{"routes": {}, "events": []}')
check('empty-scen', p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout) == {'streams': [], 'origins': {}}, p.stdout)
# raw UTF-8 vs \u escapes for latin-1 octets
raw = '{"routes":{"https://demo.test":"a"},"events":[{"sid":0,"type":"headers","fields":[[":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"],["x-v","\u00e9\u00ff"]]}]},{"sid":0,"type":"fin"}]}'
raw_utf8 = '{"routes":{"https://demo.test":"a"},"events":[{"sid":0,"type":"headers","fields":[[":method","GET"],[":scheme","https"],[":authority","demo.test"],[":path","/"],["x-v","éÿ"]]}]},{"sid":0,"type":"fin"}]}'
r1 = cli(raw.encode('utf-8')); r2 = cli(raw_utf8.encode('utf-8'))
check('escape-form', r1.returncode == 0 and r1.stdout == r2.stdout, (r1.stdout, r2.stdout, r1.stderr))
check('escape-val', b'x-v: \xe9\xff\r\n'.hex() in json.loads(r1.stdout)['origins']['a'], r1.stdout)
# ensure_ascii output is ASCII-safe and round-trips with high octets
check('ascii-out', all(b < 128 for b in r1.stdout), r1.stdout[:100])
# numeric sid sort (not lexicographic)
scen2 = {'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'a'}, 'events': []}
for sid in (100, 20, 4, 0, 64):
    scen2['events'] += [{'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/']]}, {'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'}]
out = json.loads(cli(json.dumps(scen2).encode()).stdout)
check('numeric-sort', [s['sid'] for s in out['streams']] == [0, 4, 20, 64, 100], out['streams'])
check('distinct-labels', json.loads(cli(json.dumps({'routes': {'https://a.test':'x','https://b.test':'x','https://c.test':'y'},'events':[]}).encode()).stdout)['origins'].keys() == {'x','y'})
# FIN order across many streams, offsets contiguous
ev = []
for i in range(20):
    sid = i * 4
    ev.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/p%d' % i]]})
fins = list(range(20))
order = [19, 3, 7, 0, 11, 5, 2, 13, 17, 1, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18]
for k in order:
    ev.append({'sid': k * 4, 'type': 'fin'})
out = json.loads(cli(json.dumps({'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'a'}, 'events': ev}).encode()).stdout)
offs = {s['sid']: s['offset'] for s in out['streams']}
lens = {s['sid']: s['length'] for s in out['streams']}
ok = True
pos = 0
for k in order:
    if offs[k*4] != pos: ok = False
    pos += lens[k*4]
check('many-fin-order', ok and pos == len(bytes.fromhex(out['origins']['a'])), (offs, pos))
# rejected mid-sequence does not shift later offsets
ev = [{'sid': 0, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','/a']]},
      {'sid': 4, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': [[':method','GET'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','demo.test'],[':path','//bad']]},
      {'sid': 4, 'type': 'fin'}, {'sid': 0, 'type': 'fin'}]
out = json.loads(cli(json.dumps({'routes': {'https://demo.test': 'a'}, 'events': ev}).encode()).stdout)
check('rejected-shift', out['streams'][0]['offset'] == 0 and out['streams'][1]['status'] == 'rejected'
      and out['streams'][0]['length'] == len(bytes.fromhex(out['origins']['a'])), out)
print('checks:', COUNT[0], 'failures:', len(FAIL))

# ---- scale: 4096 events, 256 streams, 8 MiB data, 2 MiB field octets
routes = {'https://host%02d.test' % i: 'rack-%d' % (i % 16) for i in range(64)}
events = []
total_data = 0
big = 'ab' * 4096   # 4096 bytes per DATA
for s in range(256):
    sid = s * 4
    fields = [[':method','POST'],[':scheme','https'],[':authority','host%02d.test' % (s % 64)],[':path','/p%d' % s]]
    for j in range(60):
        fields.append(['x-f%d' % j, 'v' * 100])   # ~ 60*105 = 6300 octets/headers -> under 8192
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'headers', 'fields': fields})
    for d in range(7):
        events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'data', 'hex': big})
        total_data += 4096
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'fin'})
    events.append({'sid': sid, 'type': 'unknown', 'frame_type': 33, 'hex': 'aabb'})
print('events', len(events), 'data bytes', total_data)
t0 = time.time()
p = cli(json.dumps({'routes': routes, 'events': events}).encode())
dt = time.time() - t0
check('scale-exit', p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[:500])
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
fwd = [s for s in out['streams'] if s['status'] == 'forwarded']
check('scale-fwd', len(fwd) == 256 and all(s['length'] > 0 for s in fwd), len(fwd))
tot = sum(len(bytes.fromhex(h)) for h in out['origins'].values())
check('scale-origins', len(out['origins']) == 16 and tot == sum(s['length'] for s in fwd), (len(out['origins']), tot))
print('scale: events=%d stdout=%.1f MiB time=%.2fs' % (len(events), len(p.stdout)/2**20, dt))
print('checks:', COUNT[0], 'failures:', len(FAIL))
sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp && python3 test_bridge3.py
